cells.note: Rebuild 2026-11-02: Togo's ministry staff said in 2025 that StatEduc with DHIS2 connects the planning department, the examinations department and the inspectorate. A January 2025 World Bank mission found the wider interconnection project not yet taken up, which does not undo the link in use.
